tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by three different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Manus raised $500 million in its first funding round since separating from Meta, reported by CNBC as Confirmed, showing strong investor backing for AI agents.
Microsoft's Copilot is gaining control over Windows and your files as the company's Recall feature faces scrutiny, Reported by Martin Cid Magazine.
Anthropic has launched Claude Haiku 5.5, its fastest and cheapest model yet with new cybersecurity safeguards, Confirmed by The Times of India.
ASUS is opening pre-orders for ProArt AI laptops equipped with Nvidia RTX Spark super chips, enabling local artificial intelligence workflows, Confirmed per 知新聞.
Microsoft's Surface Ultra laptop runs artificial intelligence locally using Nvidia's Spark, with pricing up to $5,899, Confirmed by Business Today.
